bio: On the eighth floor of the Hilton Hotel, the stylish dining room, enhanced by soft lighting and music, perfectly embodies the plush, international vibe one expects from such an establishment. The culinary score demonstrates a similar global leaning with Asian-inspired dishes such as Tom Yum soup, Gyoza dumplings, and a wide range of nigiri, sashimi and maki rolls. Simpler and occasionally Mediterranean recipes, both meat and fish, are presented tableside from a trolley, along with crab, lobster and a selection of fresh salads....
